meta.description: Guidances extraites des communiqués de résultats (8-K Item 2.02, SEC)

guidances.libelle: croissance des prêts en fin de période pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: We continue to expect 2026 period end loan growth of 18% to 20% as compared to Associated's standalone results for the year ended December 31, 2025.

guidances.libelle: croissance totale des dépôts en fin de période pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: We continue to expect 2026 period end total deposit growth of 17% to 19% and period end core customer deposit growth of 19% to 21% as compared to Associated's standalone results for the year ended December 31, 2025.

guidances.libelle: croissance des dépôts clients de base en fin de période pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: We continue to expect 2026 period end total deposit growth of 17% to 19% and period end core customer deposit growth of 19% to 21% as compared to Associated's standalone results for the year ended December 31, 2025.

guidances.libelle: croissance du revenu net d'intérêts pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: We continue to expect 2026 net interest income growth of 19% to 21% as compared to Associated's standalone results for the year ended December 31, 2025.

guidances.libelle: croissance du revenu hors intérêts pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: We now expect total noninterest income growth of 12% to 14% in 2026 as compared to Associated's standalone results for the year ended December 31, 2025.

guidances.libelle: croissance des charges hors intérêts pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: We now expect 2026 noninterest expense growth of 19% to 20% as compared to Associated's standalone results for the year ended December 31, 2025.

guidances.libelle: taux d'imposition effectif annuel pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: We now expect the annual effective tax rate to be between 20% and 22% in 2026.

guidances.libelle: titres + trésorerie / actif total pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: We continue to target securities + cash / total assets of 22% to 24% in 2026
